level.label: 2. OG — dimensional fit study
level.source: Resident-confirmed twenty-room count and general layout, fitted to Bavaria’s exterior model and checked against Rommelwood’s approximate older single-room living-zone dimensions on 15 November 2026.
level.notes: The resident confirms 20 rooms with broadly similar single-apartment types: A–D, E–G, W1–W4, L1–L3, R1–R3 and N1–N3. These are temporary study labels. Seventeen non-R candidates retain gross widths around 3.00–3.19m and share a fitted depth of about 5.40m before walls; only their corridor-facing walls move in this stage. The stairs remain against L3. R1–R3 stay unchanged and unresolved at about 2.69m gross width per bay. The published 2.70×3.30m dimension covers a living zone, not an entire apartment. No exact typical apartment, equal usable area, services, doors or floor height have been measured. Lower floors retain the earlier sketch.
